newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan opposition provincial deputy arrested.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan opposition provincial deputy arrested.

text.p: Pakistani police on Monday arrested an opposition provincial parliamentary deputy in the southern province of Sindh, provoking a protest strike in his home town of Digri, police sources and witnesses said.

Police sources said Sindh provincial assembly member Mir Hayat Mohammad Khan Talpur, who belongs to former prime minister Benazir Bhutto's Pakistan People's Party (PPP), was wanted for the recovery of a bank loan.
PPP followers accused authorities of political victimisation and closed their shops in Digri and adjoining towns to protest against the arrest, residents said.
